title: DX SDK docs - to-dos & quick notes
content:
High-level goals:
- Get SDK quickstarts in sync across Python + TS (v2 API surface).
- Add a minimal TypeScript streaming sample app (chat + function calling).
- Triage small doc gaps that cause friction in onboarding (error handling, response shapes, env setup).

Priority queue (short-term):
1) python-quickstart: update code snippets for new client ctor and streaming API (examples currently use old `.stream()` call). Reproduce locally, run sample, update README. Owner: Olivia. ETA: Mar 6.
   - TODO: run through full quickstart after PR merged; check token env variable instructions.
2) ts-streaming-sample: scaffold a tiny Next.js example showing incremental tokens, reconnect logic, and function calling + typed results. Keep <200 LOC. Owner: Devon. Blockers: missing example for reconnect/backpressure - check runtime behavior on dev machine.
3) function-calling tutorial: add a clear example showing schema-first approach + validation snippet. Add a short note about when to prefer function-calling vs structured-output. Owner: Mikaela.
4) embeddings guide: add note about normalization and batching best practices for large corpora (recommend batch size heuristic + brief cost calc). Owner: Evan.

Doc gaps observed (from onboarding calls / tickets):
- Error states from hosted API show different shapes than SDK docs describe (nested `error` vs top-level `error`). Need canonical examples for 401/429/500 and how SDK surfaces them. Link to INF-2145.
- No clear guidance on streaming reconnect/backoff - users copy/paste naive loops that double-send messages. Add a small snippet with idempotency key example.
- Missing TypeScript types for function call payloads in examples (users have to infer). Add generated types + small script to sync types from server schema.
- Quickstart has old curl example (v1 header). Replace with current auth header examples + note about key rotation.

Notes / scratch items:
- Experiment: try streaming stub with node 20 vs node 18 (performance + ESM import differences). Put results in a tiny table in the README.
- Consider adding `--machine-readable` flag to quickstart CLI to ease CI checks.
- Add small test harness in repo/tests/quickstart that runs the examples in CI (smoke test), fails gracefully if rate-limited.

Linked PRs / tickets to check before updating:
- GH #482: SDK v2 client changes (contains proposed constructor changes)
- JIRA-INF-2145: error shape mismatch (high priority)
- Confluence: DX-SDK-quickstart-v2 (draft) - sync final snippets here before merging

UX language fixes to include in edits:
- Replace all instances of "model_name" with "model" in code snippets (align with API).
- Add small note: "If you see repeated partial responses, confirm you are not re-sending the same prompt on reconnect."

Next actions (this sprint):
- Mar 4: finalize python quickstart change set, open PR. (Olivia)
- Mar 5: prototype TS streaming sample, commit to feature/ts-stream-sample. (Devon)
- Mar 6: review function-calling tutorial draft with Applied ML for schema examples. (Mikaela)

Questions / open decisions:
- Do we include a fully managed example for Dedicated customers that shows routing policy config? (probably out of scope for quickstart, but useful in "Advanced" section)
- Should we publish a short migration guide from SDK v1 -> v2 as a separate doc or as an appendix? (leaning appendix)

Quick links for follow-ups:
- PR template for DX: add checklist item "update quickstart snippets".
- Slack thread: #dx-sdk-onboarding (watch for new user complaints about streaming).

Notes-to-self: keep edits minimal and copy-friendly. Aim for <5 code changes that unblock 80% of new users.
